title: Conditions associated with the development of paediatric hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC)
tablehtml:
Condition

Characteristic features and epidemiology

HBV infection

In Asian countries:

·     Most commonly due to perinatally acquired infection

·     Sharp decrease in incidence with HBV vaccination programmes {19759364; 26256438}

In African countries:

·     HBV transmission mostly horizontal in early childhood {14708890}

In North America

·     Minority of paediatric HCC {30063586}

HCCs occur at 12–15 years of age

Marked male predominance (M:F ratio: 1.2–13.1:1)

Can arise in cirrhotic (> 50% of cases) and non-cirrhotic liver

HCC is associated with HBV genotypes B and F {15578511}

Tyrosinaemia {25081276; 25223216}

Prevalence of HCC: 14–75%

Prevalence increases with age

Dietary restriction and nitisinone treatment lead to decreased incidence, but nitisinone must be started early

GSD type 1 and type 3

HCC rare in childhood

GSD type 1

·     Develops through adenoma–carcinoma sequence

GSD type 3

·     Occurs in background of cirrhosis

Progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis

·     BSEP deficiency

·     MDR3 deficiency {28127842}

·     TJP2 deficiency {25921221; 28733884}

BSEP deficiency:

·     HCC occurs early, at 13–52 months of age {16871584}

·     Risk of HCC at 2 years of age is 5–10% {2197955}

Biliary atresia

Prevalence of HCC: ~1%

Most tumours diagnosed before 5 years of age {21489554}

Some HCCs incidental in explanted liver

Alagille syndrome {15807312; 16254531}

  

Vascular liver disease

·     Congenital portosystemic shunt (Abernethy malformation)

·     Hepatic venous outflow obstruction / Budd–Chiari syndrome

·     Congenital heart disease +/− Fontan procedure {31131680}

Congenital portosystemic shunt

·     20–50% of patients develop hepatocellular nodules (median age: 8 years), including FNH-like (60%), HCA (30%), regenerative, HBL, and HCC (2.5%) {30254403}

·     HCC may occur de novo or via malignant transformation of benign nodules {23397528; 23537576; 26138244}

α1-antitrypsin deficiency

HCC mostly in adults; rarely in children {16374862}

Mitochondrial respiratory chain disorders {15756232}

  

Genetic syndromes

·     Fanconi–Bickel syndrome {28382841}

·     Ataxia telangiectasia

·     Fanconi anaemia

·     Familial adenomatous polyposis

·     Neurofibromatosis

  

BSEP, bile salt export pump; FNH, focal nodular hyperplasia; GSD, glycogen storage disease; HBL, hepatoblastoma; HCA, hepatocellular adenoma; MDR3, multidrug resistance protein 3; TJP2, tight junction protein 2.
